sections.caption: Simulated trajectories train predictive representations and learning-based planners, while mapped waypoints guide graph-based planning and downstream control.

sections.title: Overview
paragraphs: World Model Planners provides tools to prepare recorded robot observations, train world models, evaluate them, and connect a planner to ROS 2.
The repository includes CNN, DINOv2, V-JEPA2, JEPA-lite, and DinoWM model paths, plus a ROS 2 planner bridge.

sections.title: Project workflow
paragraphs: Prepare episodes from recorded sensor data, select a world-model architecture, train and evaluate it, then use the ROS 2 wrapper to run the planner with a checkpoint.
The documentation covers setup, data preparation, model architecture, training, and the ROS 2 interface.

items.caption: Observation and proprioceptive encoders form a fused latent state; model-predictive rollouts evaluate subgoals for local trajectory planning.
